fixed: A shared dance or program whose dances have a related-dance link now imports. Before, that dance was left out, a program slot showed "Dance not imported", and the message still said the import succeeded. A related link now comes along when its dance is in the same file, or when you received that dance in an earlier file and it is in this one too or the sender added it by hand.
A dance with a video or web link imports when it comes back to a library that already has that link, such as a dance you shared and a friend sent back.
After importing a shared file, the message says how many dances could not be imported, if any.

ImportPipeline.commit gives every imported link a fresh id and adds related-dance links after the batch is written, resolving each target by external id through the batch's writes and then a dedupe index read after them, under the record's source; GenericJsonAdapter and the published-collection adapter name a related target by its record key when the file carries it. An unresolved link is dropped with an archive_related_dance_unresolved issue on the new ImportSession.issues.
